instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to disable minimap display in the editor, as I find it distracting and prefer to have more screen space for code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to modify VS Code settings.json to disable the minimap. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify the minimap is disabled.
metadata.verification: The check_json_settings function verifies that settings.json contains 'editor.minimap.enabled': false. No new functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings.json from the standard location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric check_json_settings correctly reads JSON and verifies expected key-value pairs exist
Expected value 'editor.minimap.enabled': false is semantically correct for disabling minimap
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' (accesses expected['expected'])
Complete coverage: single-step task (disable minimap) is fully verified by checking the setting
Data flow is correct: file fetch -> JSON parse -> key-value verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding postconfig to ensure settings are saved before evaluation (though VS Code typically auto-saves settings.json)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
